flowContents.comments: Self-healing test pack: Clickstream cascades. Built by flows/build_all.py.
flowContents.name: nfh-p9-clickstream

processGroups.comments: Each batch splits into 50 clicks, 100/s, into a sessionizer with one task that does 50/s. (symptom: backlog)
processGroups.name: S24 Fan-out Into One Task

processGroups.comments: The sessionizer does 10/s of the 20/s coming in, and its buffer expires FlowFiles after a minute, so half the page views vanish without a queue growing. (symptom: data_loss)
processGroups.name: S25 Expiring Session Buffer
